assets.name: -update.zip
assets.pre_install_message:
Stage MooSwitch Update Pack to /config/mooswitch/staging?

Updates CFW, patches, overlays, and homebrew while preserving your configs, sysmodule toggles, and cowMMC setup.

If you customized Horizon OC on hoc.kip, re-apply your OC profile after updating. If updating Switch firmware, quarantine custom Home Menu themes first (Ultrahand -> MooSwitch Tools).
assets.post_install_message:
MooSwitch Update Pack staged.

Reboot your Switch immediately (Sphaira Power Menu or Ultrahand -> Reboot to Hekate / Nyx). Hekate will apply the update automatically on boot.

assets.name: .zip
assets.pre_install_message:
Stage MooSwitch Full Pack to /config/mooswitch/staging?

WARNING: On next boot, Hekate will apply the Full Pack and overwrite your configs (Hekate, Nyx, Atmosphere, Sphaira, Ultrahand, sys-con, cowMMC guard) and reset default sysmodule boot toggles.

Select the -update.zip asset instead to preserve your settings.
assets.post_install_message:
MooSwitch Full Pack staged.

Reboot your Switch immediately (Sphaira Power Menu or Ultrahand -> Reboot to Hekate / Nyx). Hekate will apply the update automatically on boot.
